change: Return interrupted shared gRPC callers without waiting for state-lock cleanup or endpoint retirement while preserving owned request inputs and serialized transport cancellation

reference.observed_contract: Subchannel::QueuedCall is reference counted; its queue entry can be invalidated on cancellation while the call object owns buffered work through asynchronous cleanup

previous_boundary.remaining_boundary: registered stack Jobs joined endpoint retirement and cancellation cleanup reacquired the shared state mutex before returning
previous_boundary.risk: a caller deadline or executor cancellation could finish but remain blocked behind unrelated state ownership or transport retirement

interruption_cases: queued timeout while the state mutex remains occupied
queued executor cancellation while the state mutex remains occupied
assigned executor cancellation before endpoint retirement
after.allocation_failure_audit: every unary request-input clone allocation returns State references to baseline and frees partial ownership
after.caller_mutation_audit: path, request message, ASCII metadata and binary metadata remain byte-exact after the interrupted caller overwrites its original buffers

http2_error_path.before: an unexpected stream frame was manually freed before returning UnexpectedFrame and then freed again by errdefer
http2_error_path.after: errdefer is the sole owner on error; successful target frames still transfer ownership to the returned wrapper

interop.matrix: canonical unary/streaming compression, metadata, status, cancellation/channel reuse, health gating, ping-pong, slow-consumer and RPC/channel soak
